purpose: Structured target-language family-member profiles for current Tier 1 and Tier 2 learnable languages. The records separate relationship facts from learner-language rendering so arbitrary source/target pairs do not require pair-specific lesson files.

record_contract.target_explainer_en: Canonical English editorial explanation of the target language's kinship pattern. Other source-language renderings may localize this structured content without changing the underlying facts.
record_contract.distinctions: Only dimensions that materially affect beginner word choice. Absence from the array is not a claim that the language can never express the distinction.
record_contract.core_terms: Representative neutral beginner terms. This is not an exhaustive kinship dictionary.
record_contract.cultural_note_en: Usage/culture caution. Do not turn community tendencies into claims about every family or speaker.
record_contract.examples: Short beginner-safe examples that illustrate the profile's actual distinctions.
record_contract.source_refs: Research provenance. Generated records remain candidates until reviewed.
